dialogues.speaker: Gary
dialogues.text: I will surely defeat all my opponents just like how I chase down prey, and I'll become the best Genius Invokation TCG player in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Gary
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? You're interested in the game too? But you're not a player yet, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Gary
dialogues.text: Hehehe... When you become a true TCG player, you might even get the chance to duel me...

dialogues.speaker: Atra
dialogues.text: Do you want to be a TCG player, too? If you do, you should have this in mind:

dialogues.speaker: Atra
dialogues.text: It will be I who will become the king of Genius Invokation TCG!

dialogues.speaker: Belén
dialogues.text: Hey there, up for a game of cards? Hold on... I don't think you're an official player yet.

dialogues.speaker: Belén
dialogues.text: Come find me once you've become an official player. Perhaps there'll be something I can learn from your mistakes...

dialogues.speaker: Makri
dialogues.text: A new player, huh... You can ask Shuyun about the rules of the game, but if there's other things you wish to know...

dialogues.speaker: Makri
dialogues.text: You're always welcome to come and ask.

dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: The illustrations on some of the cards are really pretty, don't you think? I'm trying to collect them all.

dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: Beauty is also one form of victory!
